profile.subtitleJa: ベテル出身と呼ばれ、エリコを再建した人物
profile.summaryJa: ヒエルはベテル人と呼ばれ、エリコを築き直しました。基礎を据えた時に長子アビラムを、門を設けた時に末子セグブを失ったと記されています。

wikipedia.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
wikipedia.noteJa: 同名人物の一覧のHiel項目は、ベテル人ヒエルがアハブの時代にエリコを再建したと1 Kings 16:34に結び付けています。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to the LORD’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: L3180 identifies Hiel the Bethelite as rebuilding Jericho during Ahab’s reign and cites 1 Kings 16:34; this is the exact figure in the fixed WEB witness.
